title: Reading immune responses from data: T helper subsets, costimulation and killing
summary: Judge from supplied data which T helper response each traveller mounts, what two knockout mice lack, whether T-cell proliferation needs CD80/CD86 costimulation, why a CTL fails to kill by the intrinsic pathway, and which tissue shows germinal centres.

objectives.statement: Interpret immunological data: T helper subsets, costimulation, cytotoxic killing and germinal centres

steps.prompt: Which traveller is likely infected with intracellular bacteria or protozoa (Th1: IFN-γ)?
steps.correctWhen: 's' + text(first(filter(i in range(0, 3, 4): first(recorded('IFNg-pg-per-mL'))[i] == max([first(recorded('IFNg-pg-per-mL'))[0], first(recorded('IFNg-pg-per-mL'))[1], first(recorded('IFNg-pg-per-mL'))[2], first(recorded('IFNg-pg-per-mL'))[3]]))) + 1)

steps.prompt: Which traveller is likely infected with a parasitic worm (Th2: IL-5)?
steps.correctWhen: 's' + text(first(filter(i in range(0, 3, 4): first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[i] == max([first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[0], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[1], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[2], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[3]]))) + 1)

steps.prompt: Which traveller is likely infected with fungi (Th17: IL-17)?
steps.correctWhen: 's' + text(first(filter(i in range(0, 3, 4): first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[i] == max([first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[0], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[1], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[2], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[3]]))) + 1)

steps.prompt: One of the uninfected children is an outlier. What might explain it?

options.label: High IL-5 without infection: a type 2 response, as in allergy
High IL-17 without infection: a type 17 condition (an autoimmune or chronic inflammatory disease, e.g. psoriasis)

steps.correctWhen: if(max([first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[4], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[5], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[6], first(recorded('IL5-pg-per-mL'))[7]]) > 500, 'allergy', if(max([first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[4], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[5], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[6], first(recorded('IL17-pg-per-mL'))[7]]) > 500, 'th17', 'none'))

steps.prompt: What cytokine is mouse X likely deficient in?

options.label: A regulatory cytokine (IL-10 or TGF-β): Treg suppression fails, so both type 17 (EAE) and type 2 (allergy) inflammation worsen
A type 2 cytokine (IL-4, IL-5 or IL-13): allergic inflammation collapses, EAE is unchanged
A type 17 cytokine (IL-17 or IL-23): EAE is prevented

steps.correctWhen: if(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[2] > 1.3 * first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0] && first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[2] > 1.3 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0], 'regulatory', if(first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[2] < 0.5 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0] && abs(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[2] - first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0]) < 0.5, 'type2', if(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[2] < 0.5 * first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0], 'type17', if(first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[2] > 1.3 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0], 'regulatory', 'none'))))

steps.prompt: What cytokine is mouse Y likely deficient in?

options.label: A regulatory cytokine (IL-10 or TGF-β): Treg suppression fails, so both type 17 (EAE) and type 2 (allergy) inflammation worsen
A type 2 cytokine (IL-4, IL-5 or IL-13): allergic inflammation collapses, EAE is unchanged
A type 17 cytokine (IL-17 or IL-23): EAE is prevented

steps.correctWhen: if(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[3] > 1.3 * first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0] && first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[3] > 1.3 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0], 'regulatory', if(first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[3] < 0.5 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0] && abs(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[3] - first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0]) < 0.5, 'type2', if(first(recorded('EAE-score'))[3] < 0.5 * first(recorded('EAE-score'))[0], 'type17', if(first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[3] > 1.3 * first(recorded('eosinophils-1e4'))[0], 'regulatory', 'none'))))

steps.prompt: What do individual A's proliferation data show?

options.label: Antigen-specific proliferation that needs CD28 costimulation: blocking CD80 or CD86 cuts it, both together almost abolish it (each ligand can costimulate)

steps.correctWhen: if(first(recorded('cpm-A'))[1] > 10 * first(recorded('cpm-A'))[0] && first(recorded('cpm-A'))[4] < 0.3 * first(recorded('cpm-A'))[1] && first(recorded('cpm-A'))[2] < first(recorded('cpm-A'))[1], 'costimulation', 'nonspecific')

steps.prompt: How and why does individual B differ?

options.label: B's antigen-specific proliferation does not need CD80/CD86: effector or memory T cells, or another costimulatory pathway

steps.prompt: From the cytokine made, which pathogen class, and which antibody class would you expect?

options.label: IL-4: a Th2 response, typical of helminths; IL-4 switches B cells to IgE
IFN-γ: a Th1 response to an intracellular pathogen; IFN-γ favours opsonising IgG

steps.prompt: CTL2 binds and delivers granzyme B, its targets present antigen and can die by the extrinsic pathway, yet it kills none by the intrinsic pathway. Your hypothesis and test?

options.label: The target cannot release cytochrome c: granzyme B fails to free Bax from Bcl-2 (e.g. a Bcl-2 that resists cleavage, or overexpressed), so no apoptosome forms. Test: cytochrome c release and Bid/Bax activation in the targets, Bcl-2 levels or mutants

steps.prompt: After a strong IgG2a response to a virus, which biopsy shows an effective antibody response: tissue A (circular structures in the cortex) or B (cortex and medulla, no follicles)?

options.label: A: germinal centres, where B cells class-switch, hypermutate and are selected for better binding

predicates.statement: Every judgement follows from the data
predicates.check: decision('who-intracellular') == 's3' && decision('who-worm') == 's2' && decision('who-fungus') == 's1' && decision('outlier') == 'th17' && decision('mouse-x') == 'type17' && decision('mouse-y') == 'regulatory' && decision('costim') == 'costimulation' && decision('individual-b') == 'independent' && decision('pathogen') == 'intracellular-igg' && decision('ctl2') == 'bcl2' && decision('germinal') == 'a'

annotations.note: Illustrative data: traveller C Th1, A Th17, B Th2, control G high IL-17; mouse X type 17-deficient, Y regulatory-deficient; individual A costimulation-dependent, B not; IFN-γ (Th1).
